A '''Starting Interrupt''' is an [[Interrupt]] that can only be played as a starting card. Its game text has only a STARTING: function, and the slip's banner reads STARTING INTERRUPT. It is the starting-only form of the [[Used or Starting Interrupt]], which can also be played later in the game as a [[Used Interrupt]].

== In the Original Virtual sets ==
The first two appear in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]] (2004): [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|Careful Planning (V)]] for the Light Side and [[Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|Combat Readiness (V)]] for the Dark Side. The printed [[Decipher]] cards under the slips, [[Careful Planning]] and [[Combat Readiness]] from [[Endor]], are Used or Starting Interrupts. The slips drop the USED half and keep a single starting function:

: "STARTING: If your starting location was a battleground site, ▼ up to two related locations (one must be a system) with &lt; 4 total [Force icons] and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile."<ref name="vs8">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf VirtualCards8.pdf] (swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 26 October 2007) — Remaster sheet, slips 05 and 30 (errata of 25 June 2007).</ref>

The ▼ shorthand means "deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle" (see [[Virtual card icons]]). The Used or Starting Interrupts on the same sheet are placed in hand or in the Reserve Deck after their starting use; these two go to the Lost Pile.

== Later Virtual cards ==
The Players Committee kept the card type after the 2009 reorganisation. These later cards have the subtype ''Starting'' in [[GEMP]]:<ref name="gemp">GEMP card data (<code>Light.json</code> / <code>Dark.json</code>), Interrupt cards with subtype "Starting".</ref>
